speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Boerhaave Syndrome (Esophageal Rupture). The combination of forceful vomiting after alcohol consumption, followed by sudden chest pain, choking, and a history of retching is classic for esophageal rupture. The "tearing" quality of the pain and the inability to communicate suggest mediastinitis. Immediate surgical consultation and initiation of broad-spectrum antibiotics are required.
